That's not quite what that means. Look at the name of this item again in the Main List.

Spoilered for your protection
Close

This is the Cartesian Business Card. As in René Descartes. Whose most famous statement was "I think, therefore I am". Which in his native French is "Je pense, donc je suis".

Now, whether the effect is spawned by the phrase itself or (as I like to think) by that particular hand-written line is debatable, but, given this shout-out to M. Descartes, the connection to losing one's sense of self should make a lot more sense.

Very interesting idea.
The idea that your memory then personality could just break down, and you wouldn't even be aware it was happening…I find that particularly creepy.

"Je pense donc…?" Kind of threw me off. Anyone who understands the phrase becomes affected? I suppose if you found a doctor who didn't understand french or know how to use google it wouldn't be a problem, but such a common phrase in a well-known language kind of takes the mystery away from it.

Maybe if it were Latin, or some other dead language…?

upvoted regardless.
